scenarios.desc: Negative case: unrelated request must not activate the rule
scenarios.input: Rename the variable `usr` to `user` in src/auth/session.ts and update its three call sites.
scenarios.rationale: A negative case. The gate value skip-rule-not-applicable is the one label the harness treats as a negative: it selects the negative judge rubric, where a high score means the rule correctly stayed silent, and it files the scenario in the restraint pool. Every other gate value is a positive case. Give every scenario an expected_gate; a missing or misspelled one is refused rather than scored as a positive.
